name: Being A Friend
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love and support, especially in times of adversity, as a friend loves at all times and a brother is born for hardship. Genuine friends show compassion to the afflicted, standing by them rather than forsaking the fear of God. Wisdom in companionship is vital, for walking with the wise brings wisdom, while associating with fools leads to destruction. Furthermore, friendship requires guarding trust and avoiding strife, as covering transgressions fosters love, but gossip and sowing discord separate even close friends.
